card.name: Long time spans and high worth
card.fires_on: Time-span words such as years, thousands or months after verbs like take or took, and words that stress great value (worth the price, so valuable). Seen in general web prose.

modes.label: Long durations

modes.example: Crops can take<< years>> to recover and homes years more to rebuild
